method: OpenStreetMap fenced/labelled surface-site polygon (landuse or amenity), used verbatim. This is the surface enclosure at the interaction point, not a surveyed footprint of the underground cavern (no fetched source gives the cavern's own footprint). Polygon centroid (46.3097187, 6.0765792) lies 40.5 m from the CMS paper's verified coordinate for site:cern-point-5-cms (46.3095, 6.077) -- the validator's own site-mismatch check will also confirm this against that precision_m=30 m point; accuracy_m rounded up to 50 m.
